_comment: Plays before every run, on a dark confessional. The voice has no name plate. In the true ending it turns out to be Father Eli. See docs/STORY_BIBLE.md, section 6.

lines.text: Basbasan n'yo po ako, Padre, dahil nagkasala ako.
Matagal na po mula nung huli akong nangumpisal.
Hindi ko po alam kung saan magsisimula.
